unit_of_analysis.primary: completed event in logs/steps.jsonl with tool_name in agent_message, command_execution, file_change, plus task.started/task.completed
unit_of_analysis.excluded: thread/turn bookkeeping events and tool_start events to avoid double-counting started/completed pairs
unit_of_analysis.primary_label_rule: alphabetically first deterministic label; use labels field for full multi-label analysis

labels.label: task_orientation
labels.definition: The agent establishes task/workspace context before implementation.
labels.include: Initial checks of prompt implications, workspace layout, existing files, or repo status.
labels.exclude: Specific dependency probing or verification commands, which receive narrower labels.

labels.label: implementation_planning
labels.definition: The agent states or selects an implementation strategy.
labels.include: Messages describing intended file layout, architecture, endpoint design, or next coding step.

labels.label: code_generation
labels.definition: The agent creates, updates, or deletes source/configuration artifacts.
labels.include: Any file_change event that adds, updates, or deletes files in the task workspace.
labels.exclude: Read-only commands that display generated code.

labels.label: code_refinement
labels.definition: The agent makes correctness-oriented changes after an initial implementation.
labels.include: Fixing status codes, validation, edge cases, compile errors, route behavior, or persistence logic.
labels.exclude: The first creation of a file set unless the agent explicitly frames it as a fix.

labels.label: workspace_inspection
labels.definition: The agent inspects files, directories, git status, or generated source.
labels.include: Commands such as ls, find, rg --files, git status, sed/head/tail/nl/cat.
labels.exclude: Toolchain checks such as go version, npm version, or compiler discovery.

labels.label: toolchain_dependency_inspection
labels.definition: The agent checks runtime, compiler, package, framework, or module availability.
labels.include: go env, go list, node/npm/python/php/ruby checks, package-cache searches, command -v.
labels.exclude: General file inspection that is not about tool or dependency availability.

labels.label: dependency_handling
labels.definition: The agent attempts to use, install, resolve, or replace dependencies/frameworks.
labels.include: go mod tidy, npm install/build dependency failures, module-cache handling, framework import decisions.
labels.exclude: Plain toolchain version checks without a dependency decision.

labels.label: verification_static
labels.definition: The agent runs static formatting, lint, syntax, or source-level checks.
labels.include: gofmt, syntax-only compiler calls, py_compile, tsc --noEmit, direct source inspections for compile shape.

labels.label: verification_build
labels.definition: The agent builds or compiles the generated project.
labels.include: go build, cargo build, npm run build, tsc build, javac, compiler invocations for project build.
labels.exclude: Unit tests or live HTTP probes.

labels.label: verification_test
labels.definition: The agent runs an automated test suite or local unit/integration test.
labels.include: pytest, unittest, go test, npm test, jest, rails test, or hand-written test command.
labels.exclude: Build-only commands or manual curl probes.

labels.label: verification_runtime
labels.definition: The agent starts the service or probes runtime behavior.
labels.include: curl/http requests, server startup, port binding, live endpoint checks.

labels.label: failure_diagnosis
labels.definition: The agent observes or explains an error, failed command, or mismatch.
labels.include: Events with failed exit codes, error output, or messages explaining a failure cause.

labels.label: adaptation_workaround
labels.definition: The agent changes strategy in response to constraints.
labels.include: Fallback to stdlib, local compatibility layers, cache relocation, graceful degradation, framework replacement.
labels.exclude: Minor fixes that do not alter strategy.

labels.label: security_safety
labels.definition: The agent explicitly implements or discusses safety/security-relevant behavior.
labels.include: Input validation, path normalization, SQL parameterization, escaping, size limits, secret handling.
labels.exclude: Generic correctness fixes without safety relevance.

labels.label: environment_constraint
labels.definition: The trajectory encounters sandbox, network, missing binary, permission, or port constraints.
labels.include: No module/network access, missing php/django, bind denied, cache permission errors.

labels.label: final_reporting
labels.definition: The agent summarizes completed work, files, validation, or residual limits.
labels.include: Final assistant message and task.completed event.
